**About Us**
Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.
  
  
Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.
  
  
For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

To be upfront: applying doesn’t guarantee an interview or an offer, and we can’t promise when a matching role will open. If the timing isn’t right yet, we’ll keep your profile on file and reach out when there’s a role worth your time.
  
  
**About The Role**
A Software Engineer at Spreedly is hands-on and carries real ownership. Engineers design and ship features end-to-end and own parts of a system, rather than working through a queue of tickets.
  
  
The work typically spans Spreedly’s transactional API, the services that authenticate and configure customer accounts, and payment method storage and retrieval. These are Ruby on Rails services carrying live payment traffic, so the code engineers write runs against real money the day it ships.
  
  
Our engineering teams are small, pragmatic, and communicate openly. Senior engineers and architects are close by to pressure-test designs, and we expect engineers to grow into owning a domain of their own. Payments experience helps, but curiosity and solid engineering fundamentals matter more. Most of what makes this domain hard gets learned on the job.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Responsibilities vary by team and role when a position opens. They generally include:
  
  

* Design, implement, and document features end to end, from design through code review, deployment, and production support
* Debug issues that span components and services, not only the one you are working in
* Own a system or domain at the team level and steadily improve its quality, consistency, and test coverage
* Drive incident resolution in your area and land the systemic fix, not just the immediate patch
* Anticipate blockers, adjust plans, and keep delivery predictable for the work you own
* Communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product partners, and non-technical stakeholders
* Facilitate technical discussions and help your team converge on a direction
* Give actionable code review and mentor engineers newer than you
* Contribute to the SDLC, including testing, CI/CD, and the patterns your team depends on
* Share a team on-call rotation for the services you own, roughly one shift per quarter

**Candidate Requirements**

* 3+ years building and operating production software using REST services, service-oriented, or microservice architectures
* A track record of owning features or components end to end, including what happens after they ship
* Solid grounding in data structures, object-oriented design, and common design patterns
* Working knowledge of relational databases and ORM patterns. You can read a query plan and reason about an index
* Experience working in an agile team with a mature CI/CD pipeline
* Experience in a modern cloud environment. We run on AWS
* Ability to ramp up in a Ruby on Rails codebase. Direct Ruby experience is a plus, but strong experience in another dynamic language such as Python, JavaScript, PHP, or Elixir works too
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a bias toward action over waiting for direction

**Additional Skills We Value**

* Payments or fintech experience, or another regulated, high-availability domain. PCI DSS, 3DS, tokenization, and gateway integrations all count
* Distributed SQL such as CockroachDB, or database performance work at scale
* Event streaming with Kafka, or high-volume asynchronous and background processing
* Experience refactoring or extracting from a long-lived monolith
* Contributions to open source projects, technical writing, or participation in developer communities
* Experience on a distributed team working across multiple time zones

**Technologies We Use**
Ruby, Rails, Puma, Sidekiq, CockroachDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, GraphQL, Docker, AWS (KMS, S3, Secrets Manager, CodeBuild), Datadog, Sentry, LaunchDarkly, Minitest and RSpec.
  
  
The wider Spreedly platform also runs Elixir, Phoenix, and Vue.js. Exposure to any of them is helpful but not required for this role.
  
  
**Product Offerings**
Spreedly is an intelligent payments platform that gives merchants one connection to the global payments ecosystem, along with the tools to route, protect, and optimize every transaction. Key products include:
  
  

* Connect — A unified API that connects merchants to 140+ payment gateways, processors, digital wallets, and alternative payment methods worldwide, all through a single integration.
* Vault — A PCI-compliant, provider-independent repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and use it with any payment provider, while network tokens and automatic card updates keep stored cards current and approval rates high.
* Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that sends each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway, helping merchants recover lost revenue and raise authorization rates.
* Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer that lets merchants instantly add advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Fraud checks from partners like Forter and Kount can run in the same request as the payment, and built-in 3DS authentication helps merchants meet Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) requirements without separate integrations.
* Agentic — One integration that lets merchants sell inside ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI agent platforms. Agent-initiated transactions run over the merchant’s existing payment provider relationships and routing logic, so the merchant stays the merchant of record.
* Composer — A no-code visual workflow builder that brings fraud checks, identity, authentication, and payment routing onto one canvas. Built on the logic engine from Spreedly’s Dodgeball acquisition, it lets teams design and change the full transaction lifecycle without touching backend code.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* A recruiter reviews your background against the roles our Engineering org is likely to hire for.
* If it looks like a strong potential match, we’ll reach out to set up a short introductory conversation.
* If it makes sense to keep going, you may meet with an Engineering Manager for an informal conversation about your experience and interests.
* We’ll keep your profile active in our talent community. When a matching role opens, you’ll be one of the first people we contact.

There’s no cost or obligation to apply. If your situation or interests change, just let us know.
